text: יש לי פגישה עם דני מחר ב-14:00
rubric: Confirms the meeting tomorrow at 14:00 in one or two short Hebrew sentences.

text: gym tomorrow at 18:00
rubric: Confirms a gym session tomorrow at 18:00, briefly.

text: אימון בחדר כושר מחרתיים ב-19:00
rubric: Confirms the day after tomorrow at 19:00, in Hebrew.

text: dentist appointment on Monday at 9
rubric: Confirms the next Monday at 09:00; never today.

text: קבעתי טיפול שיניים ביום חמישי ב-16:00
rubric: Confirms the next Thursday at 16:00 (never today even if today is Thursday).

text: I have a meeting in 3 days at 10:30
rubric: Confirms the meeting 3 days from now at 10:30.

text: ראיון עבודה ביום שלישי ב-11:00 בחברת מר גרופ
rubric: Saves an interview on the next Tuesday at 11:00; may mention travel but must not invent a route when no route tool could run.

text: מחר: יוגה ב-8 בבוקר ופגישה ב-12
rubric: Saves BOTH items for tomorrow (yoga 08:00, meeting 12:00) and says so briefly.

text: תזכירי לי מחר ב-9 לשלוח את הדוח
rubric: Sets a reminder for tomorrow 09:00 and only claims it if a reminder or task was really created.

text: לקנות מתנה לאמא ביום שישי
rubric: Saves a flexible task on the next Friday.

text: שיחת זום עם הלקוח מחר בבוקר ב-10
rubric: Saves a Zoom call tomorrow at 10:00.

text: ללכת לבנק מחר
rubric: Saves a flexible task for tomorrow without inventing a clock time.

text: מה יש לי מחר?
rubric: Answers about tomorrow's tasks (or says there are none) without saving anything.

text: what do I have today?
rubric: Answers in English about today's tasks, briefly, saving nothing.

text: האם יש לי זמן לפגישה של שעה מחר?
rubric: Answers whether an hour fits tomorrow (should, the day is empty) without saving a task.

text: איזה יום מחר?
rubric: States the correct Hebrew weekday of tomorrow.

text: what's the date in 5 days?
rubric: States the correct date 5 days from today.

text: תודה רבה!
rubric: A warm one-line reply; nothing saved.

text: תבטלי את האימון של מחר
rubric: There is NO workout tomorrow. The reply must say it could not find one (or ask), and must NOT claim it was cancelled or removed.

text: העבירי את הפגישה עם דני ליום ראשון
rubric: No meeting with Danny exists. The reply must say it cannot find it, and must NOT claim it was moved.

text: did you save my dentist appointment?
rubric: Nothing was saved in this fresh account. The reply must say it finds no dentist appointment; it must NOT confirm one.

text: מה שעות הפתיחה של הדואר בישראל?
rubric: No web-search key is configured in this run. The reply must either say it cannot check live hours or give clearly hedged general knowledge; it must NOT present invented specific hours as verified fact.

text: תקבעי לי פגישה
rubric: No details given. The reply should ask ONE short question (what/when) and must NOT save a task.

text: remind me
rubric: Nothing to remind about. Ask one short question; do not claim a reminder was set.

text: אני גרה ברחוב דיזנגוף 100 בתל אביב
rubric: A standing fact about the user, not a task: acknowledge briefly; no task is created.

text: I usually wake up at 7:00
rubric: A routine fact, not a task: acknowledge briefly; no task is created.

text: פגישה ב-25.12 ב-10:00 עם נועה
rubric: Saves the meeting on 25 December at 10:00.

text: dinner with my sister next week
rubric: Saves a task about a week from today (the system's own rule for 'next week').

text: מתי אני צריכה לצאת לפגישה מחר?
rubric: There is no meeting tomorrow. The reply must say so; it must NOT invent a leave-by time or a route.

text: תכתבי לי ברשימה: לקנות חלב היום
rubric: Saves 'buy milk' for today, in one short line.

text: להתקשר לדותן מחר ב 9 וחצי בבוקר
rubric: Saves ONE call with Dotan tomorrow at 09:30, with no place; replies in Hebrew, one short line.

text: תשמרי את השיחה מחר ב 9 וחצי עם דותן! ושימי לי שעון מעורר מתאים
rubric: Saves ONE call with Dotan tomorrow at 09:30 and an alarm on it (about 09:00); never a task called 'alarm'; replies in Hebrew, not English.

text: call Dotan at 9:30 in the morning and set an alarm
rubric: Saves ONE call with Dotan at 09:30 with an alarm before it; never a task named alarm; no place; replies in English.

text: להתקשר לאמא בשמונה בערב
rubric: Saves a call with mom today at 20:00, no place, one short Hebrew line.

text: ראיון עבודה מחר ב-11 בהרצליה ותעירי אותי ב-8
rubric: Saves ONE interview tomorrow at 11:00 in Herzliya with an alarm at 08:00; never a separate alarm task; Hebrew.

text: dentist next Monday at 4pm
rubric: Saves a dentist appointment on the next Monday at 16:00, briefly, in English.

text: פגישה עם רונית ביום חמישי ב-10 בבוקר
rubric: Saves a meeting with Ronit on the next Thursday at 10:00; Hebrew.

text: תזמני לי שיחת זום עם הצוות מחרתיים ב-15:30
rubric: Saves a zoom call the day after tomorrow at 15:30 with no place and no route; Hebrew.
